content:
Context: 4. Control of staff cars and responsibilities of Controlling Officers

The Controlling Officer shall maintain a Logbook, a record of repairs and replacements, a register showing cost of petrol, etc., consumed and all incidental receipts and expenditure and an inventory of the equipment.  
- Para. 3 of OM, dated 1-9-2022
